# Viktor Nešić — Senior Mobile Developer

> Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

Viktor has more than ten years in software and over twenty mobile apps delivered: enterprise products for international brands (Hansgrohe, Migros, CGIAR, Bucherer, KOCH, Philip Morris) at the agency Merkle (dentsu), and MVPs and products for independent clients. Strengths: native iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit), native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), Kotlin Multiplatform with shared logic, offline-first apps, Firebase backends, mobile accessibility, design systems and code reviews of inherited apps.

## Case studies

- [Hansgrohe ProApp](https://vprogrammers.me/work-proapp): An enterprise iPad app that puts Hansgrohe's and AXOR's whole product world in a sales rep's hands: catalogue, product stories and ready-made presentations, all available offline in showrooms, on building sites and wherever the network drops.
- [Migros iMpuls](https://vprogrammers.me/work-migros): Keeping iMpuls, the health and wellbeing app from Switzerland's largest retailer, stable, current and shipping on schedule.
- [Bucherer](https://vprogrammers.me/work-bucherer): A quick iOS proof of concept for a luxury watch retailer: can the existing online shop, partly built on Salesforce, run inside a native app, keep customers signed in and complete a purchase?
- [MuMe](https://vprogrammers.me/work-mume): An Android app for live video chat rooms: hosts open a room, guests join by paying with coins, and the conversation happens in real time.
- [CGIAR](https://vprogrammers.me/work-cgiar): A responsive, component-driven frontend for CGIAR, the global agricultural research partnership: reusable components that the client's editors assemble into pages in Drupal.
- [Hanze3](https://vprogrammers.me/work-hanze3): A live radio app for an Egyptian broadcaster: listeners tune in, chat in real time behind a profanity filter and book their own on-air slot once a moderator approves it.
- [PhotoStory](https://vprogrammers.me/work-photostory): Crew scheduling for a photo studio: the admin books an event and invites the crew, each member accepts or declines from a push notification, and a declined offer moves on to the next person.
- [BezBrige!](https://vprogrammers.me/work-bezbrige): A sales CRM for insurance agents: assigned leads, call outcomes and awareness levels guide every client from the first call to a signed contract for insurance, credit or an investment fund.
- [Sliike](https://vprogrammers.me/work-sliike): A native iOS app for a beauty booking platform for Afro-American women in Canada: discover salons and stylists, choose a service and a time, and get reminded before the appointment.
- [KOCH Scan App](https://vprogrammers.me/work-koch): A review of the KOCH Scan App, a B2B app for a Swiss building supplier that lets tradespeople scan article labels, collect them by commission and order on site, in preparation for taking over its maintenance.
- [PMI Market(i)](https://vprogrammers.me/work-pmi): A technical audit of Market(i), an internal iPad and iPhone app for Philip Morris field teams in the Nordics, and a roadmap for maintaining its legacy Objective-C codebase.
- [Swipe XYZ](https://vprogrammers.me/work-swipe-xyz): A native iOS shopping app for a fashion and footwear retailer in the Arab world, combining classic browsing with a swipe-to-like product feed that sends favourites straight to the bag.
- [Goaleadors](https://vprogrammers.me/work-goaleadors): A fantasy football platform spanning Europe's top five leagues: draft a squad on a budget, score every matchday and climb a multi-tier league pyramid in free or premium play.
- [Bikini](https://vprogrammers.me/work-bikini): Android and iOS apps for a bikini competition in Asia: contestants post videos and photos, fans follow, vote and buy extra votes, judges score every stage, and live calls bring the audience close to the contestants.
- [ÇocukFlix](https://vprogrammers.me/work-cocukflix): A safe cartoon app for Turkish children: curated cartoons in Turkish, favourites and notifications, with a parental gate that keeps the settings in grown-up hands.
- [Design Token Pipeline](https://vprogrammers.me/work-design-tokens): An assessment of an enterprise design system that app teams in many countries build on, and a proposal for an automated token pipeline from Figma to Web, iOS and Android, with accessibility built in and a safe way to rename tokens.
- [Anubis](https://vprogrammers.me/work-anubis): Anubis (Automatic Network User Based Interface System): a server-driven UI framework for Kotlin Multiplatform. Screens are described as JSON on a Ktor server and rendered natively with Compose, so layouts can change without an app release.
- [YAMVIP](https://vprogrammers.me/work-yamvip): YAMVIP (Yet Another MVI Presenter): a multiplatform MVI engine that shares presentation logic between Android and iOS, with a strict split between Model, UIState, Intent and Effect.
- [KMP Template](https://vprogrammers.me/work-kmp-template): A production-ready starting point for Kotlin Multiplatform apps: a modular clean architecture with YAMVIP and Anubis, a 100% Compose Android app, a 100% SwiftUI iOS app and CI from the first commit.
- [Masse](https://vprogrammers.me/work-masse): Online booking for a billiard club: guests reserve a pool table or a dartboard for a free slot, while an admin panel manages the data and the evening's reservations.
- [AppleDetect](https://vprogrammers.me/work-appledetect): An iOS app that grades apples with on-device machine learning: the camera detects every apple in a crate, a Core ML model sorts each one into quality classes, and the result guides which crate it goes into.
- [Cryptocent](https://vprogrammers.me/work-cryptocent): A cryptocurrency market app for Android: live prices, sparklines and detailed charts from the CoinGecko API, with onboarding, sign-in and sections for trading, a portfolio and a wallet, delivered as an MVP.
- [Feniks](https://vprogrammers.me/work-feniks): An Android tablet app for an ice cream shop that tracks what is left of every flavour across two display cases and tells the kitchen which flavour to make next.
- [DigitalPass](https://vprogrammers.me/work-digitalpass): A digital pass prototype for Android: accounts and passes backed by signed JWT credentials, decoded on the device, with live expiry countdowns, online status and credential renewal.
- [ConnectClub](https://vprogrammers.me/work-connectclub): A members' club app for taxi drivers: sign in with Face ID, verify a driving licence by photographing both sides, carry a member badge and unlock offers from partner companies.
- [Yaaxa](https://vprogrammers.me/work-yaaxa): A short-video social app for iOS that connects people through the videos they share: record with AR avatars and effects, add filters, stickers and music, film duets side by side, and find matches in the feed.
- [MyPH](https://vprogrammers.me/work-myph): A social and dating app for Android that brings people together by city: build a profile, join your city's group chat, make friends, and sign in with Facebook or Google, with a web admin panel behind it.
- [Houseleek Renhold](https://vprogrammers.me/work-houseleek): A presentation app for a Norwegian cleaning company: every service, from homes and offices to stairs, windows and car care, with photos, a short description and a direct line to book.
- [PerfectMatrimony](https://vprogrammers.me/work-perfectmatrimony): A matchmaking app for an Indian client: members fill in a detailed profile, and the app searches the database and suggests partners whose details match, with the community and family preferences that matter in Indian marriages.

## Open source

- [a11yOtp](https://github.com/Vprogrammers/a11yOtp): accessible one-time-code input for Compose Multiplatform (Android and iOS)
- [Mobile A11y Agent Skills](https://github.com/Vprogrammers/mobile-a11y-agent-skills): accessibility agents and skills for Android, iOS and KMP
- [Mobile A11y Agent Skills Lite](https://github.com/Vprogrammers/mobile-a11y-agent-skills-lite): the copy-ready edition
